notes: 2026-09-10 fact pass. CORRECTION to the seed note: there IS an online sermon archive. The church's own website is a one-page WordPress placeholder that says 'VALLEY CHRISTIAN CHURCH WEBSITE IS UNDER CONSTRUCTION' and does nothing but link to its YouTube channel, https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCoMGoicou90d8IKiaCI51ig (handle @valleychristianchurchofsah3919), which has weekly 'Sunday Message' videos running to at least 2026-09-06. Address 18140 S La Canada Dr, Sahuarita AZ 85629 was already geocode 'verified' and is corroborated by the Christian Standard directory; left unchanged. Denomination changed from the '(verify)' placeholder to 'Independent Christian Church', which is how the Christian Standard directory (the Christian Churches / Churches of Christ trade paper) categorises it; the church itself publishes no doctrinal or affiliation statement anywhere I could find, so treat this as directory-level, not self-stated. PASTOR NAMES ARE WEAK: because the site is a placeholder there is no staff page. The YouTube titles only ever give first names or initials - 'Pastor Ken', 'John G', 'Pastor Bruce G', 'Elder John G', and an older 'Pastor Dave'. 'Ken Reesman, Pastor' is corroborated by the Christian Standard directory and by a ZoomInfo record showing a @vcchurchsahuarita.com email, so he is retained, but he is NOT confirmed on a church-controlled page. Do not add Bruce, John G or Dave until full names are confirmed - phone the church at (520) 403-9434 or check a bulletin. Sunday School 10:00 AM, worship 11:00 AM.
